commands.cmd: bun run --cwd apps/customer-assets test:worker -- tests/auth-runtime.test.ts tests/upload-runtime.test.ts

notes: All fixture values are synthetic (example .fixture domains, generated byte arrays); captured magic-link mail is referenced by id in tests only. No tokens, cookies, keys, real emails, or login URLs are recorded here.

Auth (15 tests): magic-link happy path with hashed stored token (verification rows never contain the raw token), expired-token fail, replay fail, unknown-email neutral response with signup refusal (no session, no user row), disableSignUp, session get/sign-out, admin-only server-side provisioning (default role member), API key create/verify/revoke with revocation effective on next verify, scope enforcement at verify (granted scope passes, admin scope fails), key never mints a session, guarded /api/auth/api-key/* returns 403 for member sessions and agent keys.

better-auth 1.7.7 observed behaviors proven by tests: storeToken 'hashed'; single-use atomic token consumption; disableSignUp gates signup at VERIFY time (sendMagicLink still fires for unknown emails and a verification row is created - production must keep rate limiting on); HTTP /api-key/create rejects explicit permissions with 400 SERVER_ONLY_PROPERTY, so scopes are settable only server-side via auth.api.createApiKey; /api-key/delete is session-guarded (sessionMiddleware) even server-side.

Transactional adapter config: drizzle-orm/d1 .transaction() fails on D1 with 'Failed query: begin' (asserted in test) - interactive BEGIN/COMMIT is unsupported, so @better-auth/drizzle-adapter runs with transaction:false (sequential statements, its default). Atomic multi-statement work stays on D1 batch/CAS in P-002 per contracts.md SS6. No atomicity is faked.

Upload runtime (9 tests): streaming byte counter rejects trailing/extra bytes and hard-cap overruns DURING the read; staged write uses FixedLengthStream sized to declaredBytes so short bodies also fail with no staging object committed (asserted via head() = null after every rejection); magic-signature detection for jpeg/png/webp/mp4 rejects others incl. HEIC brands; wrong signatures rejected at the 12-byte ftyp window; incremental SHA-256 (@noble/hashes, pure JS, Workers-compatible) verified against single-shot digest; finalizeUpload streams the staged object for server-side re-verification (size+hash+signature) and writes the final key exactly once (rewrite attempt = final_conflict, bytes unchanged); simulated 50 MiB mp4 streamed in 64 KiB chunks with maxChunkBytes <= chunk size (no full buffering) and streamed finalize.

Write-once strategy recorded by finalizeUpload: 'conditional-copy' when the runtime's R2 copy binding honors onlyIf etagDoesNotMatch '*', else streamed fixed-length put behind a head check ('streaming-put-head-check'). Single-isolate guarantee proven; any cross-isolate race window is documented, not hidden.

Bundle: vite build emits dist/client + dist/server (main index.js, nodejs_compat); grep of dist/server shows zero node:fs and zero node:path imports (only node:crypto/node:stream/node:async_hooks/node:sqlite references, permitted under nodejs_compat). packages/customer-assets/src/contracts.ts has no import statements at all (pure types + const tables).

Command-order quirk on bun 1.4.2: 'bun --cwd apps/customer-assets run test:worker' silently lists root scripts and runs nothing; the working form is 'bun run --cwd apps/customer-assets <script>'. Recorded here so future reproduction uses the working form; semantics identical.
